authors.bio: Joseph Polonsky was a Technical Director of Thomson-CSF, Broadcast and Television Division (France), until his retirement in 1978. He remains as a consultant to the board. He is a Fellow of the SMPTE and of the Royal Television Society; lecturer at the Ecole Superieure d'Electronique and at the Ecole Polytechnique of Grenoble; and a member of the Council of the Societe d'Electriciens et d'Electroniciens (France). He is also a member of the Program Committee of the Montreux International Television Symposium and a member of the Scientific Council of the Eduard Rhein Foundation (Germany).
